text:
ana: Quick heads-up — planning to unpin runtime v2.15 from canary pool tomorrow 02:00 UTC to re-enable the new kernel path. Need confirmation on fallback routing, SDK shim compatibility for quantized models, and model pin validity. @mike @tess

mike: Are we unpinning across all regions or just canary EU-west? If EU-only, recommend keeping the SDK shim enabled for 24h after the unpin. Also can someone sanity-check the deploybot pinlist before the window?

deploy-bot: [automated] Pinlist update scheduled: unpin runtime 2.15 -> 2.15-unpinned at 2024-09-18T02:00:00Z. Affected routes: /chat, /embeddings. Fallback routing will remap to runtime 2.14-compatible variants where available.

tess: Adding telemetry checklist: please ensure prefix-cache warmup, kv-cache eviction, and large-batch latency are tracked. I'm creating a smoke-eval group for long-sequence and quantized models now.

ryan: Rollback playbook reminder: if P50 latency > 250ms or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m on the canary cohort, trigger rollback to pinned runtime 2.14 and disable the new kernel path. Manual rollback quick command: `./scripts/rollback-runtime --to 2.14 --scope canary` — full steps in runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-rollback>.

ana: Thanks. @deploy-bot can you open a pinlist diff and attach the fallback routing snippet so we can review before the window?

deploy-bot: [automated] Pinlist diff created: /pin/diffs/7876543210 — includes fallback routes and SDK_shim flag = true. Snippet:```json
{
  "route": "/chat",
  "from": "runtime:2.15",
  "fallback": "runtime:2.14-compat",
  "sdk_shim": true
}``` Please review.

mike: Quick SDK question — are shim toggles fully backward-compatible for embedded quantized models? If not we should gate on header `x-client-sdk-version >= 2.8` during rollout.

tess: ACK. I'll add header gating to the smoke evals and leave a note in the Release Notes draft (section: Canary runtime unpin).

ana: :thumbsup: All right, proceeding with canary unpin tomorrow 02:00 UTC. I'll post final go/no-go 30m before. If anyone sees anything blocking, flag here or ping me directly.
